title: Escrow Interest Day Count by Campus Escrow Bank, Entrance Fee Agreement
content:
**Day count.** For the escrowed deposit of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** cancelled before occupancy by the resident, the day count follows the escrow bank of the campus: at Larkspur at Willow Creek the interest is the deposit times the combined rate times the accrual days divided by 360; at Larkspur at Brookfield the interest is the deposit times the combined rate divided by 12 for each whole month from the deposit's posting date to the cancellation date; at any other campus the interest is the deposit times the combined rate times the accrual days divided by 365; in every case the interest is rounded to the cent half up.

**Use in the refund.** Where the escrowed deposit earned escrow interest, the refund on a resident's own cancellation before occupancy is the money received less the processing fee retained plus that escrow interest, added once to the net amount and rounded to the cent half up.

The combined rate is the deposit's annual escrow rate with any term bonus added, expressed in percent a year. The campus is the one named in the agreement.

## Campus table

| Campus | Interest |
|---|---|
| Larkspur at Willow Creek | Deposit, multiplied by the combined rate, multiplied by the accrual days, divided by 360 |
| Larkspur at Brookfield | Deposit, multiplied by the combined rate, divided by 12, multiplied by the whole months from posting to cancellation |
| Larkspur at Harbor View | Deposit, multiplied by the combined rate, multiplied by the accrual days, divided by 365 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: deposit 40000.00, combined rate 2.45 percent, posted 1 March, cancellation 30 May, 85 accrual days)

| Campus | Calculation | Interest |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur at Willow Creek | 40000.00 at 2.45 percent is 980.00 a year; multiplied by 85 and divided by 360 | 231.39 |
| Larkspur at Harbor View | 980.00 multiplied by 85 and divided by 365 | 228.22 |
| Larkspur at Brookfield | 980.00 divided by 12, for 2 whole months | 163.33 |

On a hypothetical net amount of 27272.00 (money received less the processing fee) at Willow Creek, the refund is 27272.00 plus 231.39, that is 27503.39.
